adjudication.rationale: The finding identifies a real bug in the migration. Looking at the migration code, it directly inserts hosts from the old site_settings into embeddable_hosts table using raw SQL: `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, category_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)"`. This bypasses the EmbeddableHost model's before_validation callback that normalizes hosts by stripping 'http://', 'https://', and paths. The old setting allowed entries like 'https://example.com/1234' (as shown in the test on line 70-72 of embed_controller_spec.rb). After migration, these would be stored as-is, but the new `record_for_host` method extracts just the hostname from URLs and compares with `where("lower(host) = ?", host)`, which would fail to match the unnormalized migrated data.
